why: One tool and its tests: scripts/ops/merge_json_register.py's REFUSAL path now writes git-shaped, deliberately invalid-JSON conflict markers into %A instead of leaving pure OURS (valid, marker-free, and missing every THEIRS-only row -- 8 lost on PR #11957), plus a row-preservation post-condition on the clean path, the tests/ops/test_merge_json_register.py assertions that had been PINNING the defect, one .gitattributes comment carrying the same false claim, and three backlog rows. No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no live-VM mutation, no secret. Nothing in LANDING_MACHINERY: merge_json_register.py is not one of its twelve entries, and neither is .gitattributes. Evidence is planted-defect and reproduction, not a green run: the defect was reproduced end to end through a REAL git merge against the pre-fix driver (markers 0, valid JSON yes, ONLY-THEIRS 0 occurrences, and a commit carrying ['A', 'ONLY-OURS']) and the fix verified the same way; six mutations each shown to land and to fail the suite, with one vacuous assertion found and repaired when a marker-rename plant escaped. 24 tests pass, ruff clean, and the full guard set is 77 pass / 1 fail where the single failure is this guard pre-arming.
